ticker_news.title: Netflix To Acquire Warners Bros Discovery In Massive $82.7 Billion Deal: NFLX Stock Falls Over 2%, WBD Gains 3% In Premarket
ticker_news.description: Netflix announced plans to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery for $82.7 billion, adding major entertainment franchises like Batman, Harry Potter, and Game of Thrones to its content portfolio. The deal is expected to close in Q3 2026 and faces potential antitrust challenges.
ticker_news.author: Eva Mathew

ticker_news.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Futures Pare Losses As Investors Await Fed's Preferred Inflation Data— Netflix Inks $82.7B Deal For Warner Bros (UPDATED)
ticker_news.description: U.S. stock futures recovered early losses ahead of the Federal Reserve's PCE inflation data. Netflix announced an $82.7 billion deal to acquire Warner Bros Discovery, while job cuts fell 53% month-over-month in November. Markets anticipate potential interest rate cuts in December.
ticker_news.author: Rishabh Mishra
